description: Make a new album with a cover, a blurb and a song list, and start its first song.

offer.reason: adult on their own written screen with music enabled and no album already open in the chat

author: MaiPai

examples: make me an album about summer road trips
create an album for this band with a cover and a first song
make a lofi study album in this style
put together a new album called Night Garden
I want a whole album, not just one song

idea.description: What the album is about, in the person's own words, short.

band.description: A made band's id (mband-...), only when the person named a band in this chat. Otherwise leave out.

song_style.description: A saved song style's id (sstyle-...), only when the person named one. Otherwise leave out.
